title: Extended-state DMT trials yield encounters with sentient others
place_text: Imperial College London; University of California San Diego

tellings.quote: minutes. And And those volunteers are all coming back with reports of encounters with sentient others.

plain: In the 2020s, studies at Imperial College London and the University of California San Diego kept volunteers on DMT, a powerful psychedelic, for longer stretches than usual, and those volunteers are said to come back reporting meetings with thinking beings. The writer Graham Hancock describes these trials without naming a source, saying the volunteers "are all coming back with reports of encounters with sentient others," and ties them to the neuroscientist Andrew Gallimore and the researcher Rick Strassman. If true, it would suggest the drug opens onto a realm where other minds can be met.
